entities.name: Ebirri
entities.description: Rakshasa vizier of the Sultai in Tarkir's original timeline who bound the monk Taigam to him.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: Jeskai monk turned traitor who became Sidisi's chief advisor while sworn to Ebirri.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: Clan of Tarkir ruled by Sidisi.

entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: Brood tyrant and khan of the Sultai.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Khan of the Jeskai, named by assassins as their sender.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Plane in whose original timeline Ebirri lived.

events.summary: Ebirri binds himself to Taigam, teaching dark magic in exchange for his life's service.
events.quote: Taigam swore his life in service of the rakshasa

events.summary: Taigam rises to chief advisor of Sidisi and executes her decrees.
events.quote: Taigam rose to the chief advisor of Sidisi

events.summary: Jeskai assassins attack Taigam and Ebirri emerges from the shadows.
Ebirri crushes a monk's head and chokes another with magic.
events.quote: Ebirri crushed it, exploding brain and skull all over the cabin

events.summary: Ebirri reminds Taigam that he owns him and kills the last monk.
events.quote: He reminded Taigam that he owned him

relations.quote: Taigam swore his life in service of the rakshasa
